'''Aurionpro Solutions Limited''' is a technology company, headquartered in [[Navi Mumbai]], India. It primarily serves the banking, mobility, payments, and government sectors.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |last=Gupta |first=Arbind |title=Aurionpro Solutions: Transforming businesses |url=https://businessindia.co/magazine/aurionpro-solutions-transforming-businesses |access-date=2023-07-30 |website=businessindia.co |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=3qxaAAAAYAAJ&q=%22Aurionpro%22 |title=Major Information Technology Companies of the World |date=2009 |publisher=Graham & Whiteside. |isbn=978-1-86099-579-8 |language=en}}</ref> Aurionpro is a publicly listed company, traded on the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE) and [[National Stock Exchange of India]] (NSE), with a market capitalization exceeding Rs 76 billion as of 15th May 2025.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Annual report analysis |url=http://innovision.sushilfinance.com/Modules/Files/Company%20Report/Aurionpro%20Solutions%20Ltd.%20-%20Reinstating%20Coverage%20-%20Feb.2022_28Feb2022135639.pdf |access-date=2023-07-30 |website=[[Sushilfinance]]}}</ref><ref name=":1">{{Cite web |last=Chakraborty |first=Pradeep |date=2023-03-23 |title=Aurionpro's platform-led one converged digital ecosystem covers banking kiosk apps to smart mobility solutions |url=https://www.dqindia.com/aurionpros-platform-led-one-converged-digital-ecosystem-covers-banking-kiosk-apps-to-smart-mobility-solutions/ |access-date=2023-07-30 |website=[[Dataquest]] |language=en-US}}</ref>

== History ==
Aurionpro was incorporated on 31 October 1997 as Value Added Information Distribution Services Private Limited.<ref name=":2" /> It later changed its name to VAIDS Technologies Private Limited on 30 April 2001 and subsequently to Aurionpro Solutions Private Limited on 18 September 2003.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Aurionpro Solutions Ltd |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/stocks/aurionpro-solutions-ltd/ |access-date=2023-07-30 |website=www.thehindubusinessline.com |language=en}}</ref> As of March 2023, Aurionpro has 24 offices in 22 countries, with over 2000 employees.<ref name=":2" />

The company is led by [[Paresh Zaveri]], the chairman and managing director. In July 2022, Ashish Rai became the vice chairman and president of Aurionpro,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ashish Rai joins Aurionpro Solutions as Vice Chairman & President |url=https://indiainfoline.com/article/news-top-story/ashish-rai-joins-aurionpro-solutions-as-vice-chairman-amp-president-122072600419_1.html |access-date=2023-07-30 |website=indiainfoline.com |language=en}}</ref> while Sanjay Bali heads the Tech Innovation Group,<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-12-07 |title=SBI picks Aurionpro to provide solutions for Kanpur Metro Project |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/national/sbi-picks-aurionpro-to-provide-solutions-for-kanpur-metro-project/article37880603.ece |access-date=2023-07-29 |website=www.thehindubusinessline.com |language=en}}</ref> and Shekhar Mullatti is in charge of the banking division.<ref name=":1" />

== Subsidiaries ==
In 2020, Aurionpro acquired a majority stake of 51% in SC Soft, a [[Singapore]]-based IT company that develops software for transportation fare collections.<ref>{{Cite web |last=chundawat |date=2022-06-10 |title=Aurionpro Solutions trades higher on increasing stake in SC Soft {{!}} Udaipur Kiran |url=https://udaipurkiran.com/aurionpro-solutions-trades-higher-on-increasing-stake-in-sc-soft/ |access-date=2023-07-30 |language=en-US}}</ref>

Integro, an IT company, is a subsidiary of Aurionpro.<ref name=":0" /> 

== Partnerships with state governments ==

* In January 2023, Aurionpro Payments Singapore launched a payment gateway platform called 'AuropayBiz,' to enable businesses to receive digital payments and formed partnerships with 'Stripe Payments' and 'FIS Worldpay.'<ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite news |title=Aurionpro Payments gets RBI approval to operate as payment aggregator |work=Business Standard |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/aurionpro-payments-gets-rbi-approval-to-operate-as-payment-aggregator-123050500595_1.html |access-date=2023-07-30}}</ref>
* On February 21, 2023, Aurionpro's subsidiary, Integro Technologies, partnered with Finastra.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |date=2023-02-22 |title=Aurionpro Solutions' arm partners with Finastra to provide exposure risk offerings for trade finance |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/stocks/aurionpro-solutions-arm-finastra-partnership-trade-innovation-solutions-16001321.htm |access-date=2023-07-30 |website=cnbctv18.com |language=en}}</ref>
* On April 28, 2021, SC Soft Pte. Limited, a subsidiary of Aurionpro, and [[Mastercard|MasterCard]] signed a strategic alliance for automatic fare collection and payment solutions.<ref name=":2" />
* On June 24, 2022, Aurionpro engaged with the [[Government of Rajasthan]] to expand the latter's 3D City platform in [[Jaipur]].<ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=2018-03-22 |title=AurionPro Solutions rises 4% on winning Jaipur's 3D City project of Rs 180cr |url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/stocks/aurionpro-solutions-bags-order-for-jaipurs-3d-city-project-of-rs-180cr-2533717.html |access-date=2023-07-30 |website=Moneycontrol |language=en}}</ref>
* On November 29, 2022, Aurionpro implemented the [[National Common Mobility Card]] (NCMC) based open loop ticketing system and [[Global Positioning System|GPS system]] at all depots/sub-depots of Haryana Roadways, a state government undertaking.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |last=Parashar |first=Brajendra K |date=23 October 2021 |title=Mumbai firm bags contract more than a year after bidding process began |url=https://www.pressreader.com/india/hindustan-times-lucknow/20211023/281745567589677 |access-date=2023-07-30 |website=[[Hindustan Times]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-08-25 |title=Three pvt firms in race to get UPSRTC's e-ticketing tender |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/lucknow-news/three-pvt-firms-in-race-to-get-upsrtc-s-e-ticketing-tender-101629913873914.html |access-date=2023-07-30 |website=Hindustan Times |language=en}}</ref>

== Awards ==

* Aurionpro was recognized as a Great Place To Work for two consecutive years.<ref>{{Cite news |title=Aurionpro wins order from the large private sector bank |work=[[United News of India]] |url=https://www.uniindia.com/news/business-economy/aurionpro-order/2835430.html |access-date=2023-07-30}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Aurionpro Solutions certified as 'Great Place to Work'; Stock ends 3.5% higher |url=https://indiainfoline.com/article/news-top-story/aurionpro-solutions-certified-as-great-place-to-work-stock-ends-higher-122031000244_1.html |access-date=2023-07-30 |website=[[India Infoline]] |language=en}}</ref>
* Its subsidiary, Integro Technologies, was named as a global category leader in Credit Lending Operations by Chartis, a research and analysis organization for Risk Technologies.<ref>{{Cite news |date=31 October 2022 |title=Investor presentation October 2022 |url=https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/a4f31966-2867-4f6d-a2f2-643260698cdc.pdf |access-date=2023-07-30}}</ref>
* Received the India Technology Excellence Award in the Digital– Technology category at the Asian Technology Excellence Awards 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-09-06 |title=Most outstanding technological projects and innovations recognised at the Asian Technology Excellence Awards |url=https://asianbusinessreview.com/co-written-partner/event-news/most-outstanding-technological-projects-and-innovations-recognised-asian-technology-excellence-awards |access-date=2023-07-30 |website=Asian Business Review |language=en}}</ref>
